name: Latvia
exam_name: Test of knowledge of the basic principles of the Constitution, the text of the national anthem, and the basics of the history and culture of Latvia
administering_agency: Office of Citizenship and Migration Affairs (PMLP)

format.notes: Taken orally or in writing, and can be taken online. In writing: 18 questions (10 on history and culture, 8 on the Constitution) and writing out the anthem. Orally: one question on the Constitution, one on history and culture, and reciting the anthem. Each part is marked separately and all must be passed.

exemptions.age: People aged 65 or over have relief from testing.
exemptions.disability: Group I disabled people, group II with progressive mental illness, and group II or III with deafness are exempt from both examinations; other reliefs depend on the disability.

unverified.official_study_material: A study aid by J. Taurēns is named by the office in a search summary; its page was not read.

notes: A Latvian language test is required as well. No more than three attempts within one application.
